description: This file contains Italian translations for the Select2 JavaScript library, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines localized strings used for user interface messages in Italian.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to enter more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable elements.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while searching.
